component.name: Flow Linux
component.summary: Hold-to-talk voice dictation for KDE Wayland

description.p: Flow Linux is a push-to-talk dictation daemon. Hold a global hotkey, speak, release, and the transcript is pasted into the focused app.
It targets KDE Wayland. Speech can run offline with a local Whisper model (downloaded on demand) or with your own OpenAI API key. No keys are bundled.
Host tools are still required: PipeWire, wl-clipboard, a ydotool user service, and the desktop portal. The in-app Ready page reports mute, hotkey, model, and injection problems.
First public OSS release: Ready-bar diagnostics, in-app Whisper download, and a stable portal app id.
